notes:
Lead source: PLG signup (API key created via quickstart). Indie dev duo building a micro-SaaS that surfaces code snippets + conversational search over user repos.

Quick facts:
- Signed up 2026-02-25, started hitting /v1/generate with test prompts.
- Low expected monthly volume initially (~50k-200k tokens/month). Cost sensitive.
- Wants hosted API only for now; no AE touch requested.
- Prefers small/efficient models (3B-ish or quantized variants) if Redwood offers lower-cost tiers.
- Asks: streaming support? prefix caching? token cost per model?

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-02-25: self-serve signup, API key minted, first test request logged.
- 2026-03-02: 20min recorded call with founder (fireflies ff_20260302_1187) — demoed prototype, asked about cost, latency, and model switching.
- 2026-03-04: emailed for rate limit details (thread:kg3h3k2pm).
- 2026-03-10: in-app onboarding completed; tried streaming endpoint; reported intermittent 250-400ms tail latency on a few requests.

Notes from call (founder quotes):
- "We need predictable cost per active user — can't spike our burn."
- "Streaming is a must for chat UX; latency under ~200ms would be ideal but we're flexible early on."

Technical / requirements summary:
- Workload: chat-first product with code assistant features and one-shot summarization.
- Latency target: p95 under 300ms for short responses (<=150 tokens) to keep UX snappy on web.
- Throughput: low; concurrency rarely >10 at this stage.
- Model preference: open/compatible models; interested in Redwood's curated smaller models or recommendations for cost vs quality.
- Routing/fallback: wants simple fallback to cheaper model when bursty traffic occurs.
- Compliance: minimal for now; wants audit logs and ability to rotate keys.

POC / trial notes:
- Using hosted API with a single API key. Has instrumented basic metrics in Sentry.
- Asked for sample SDK snippets for streaming + reconnection.
- Wants clear doc on throttling behavior and quota limits for free tier.

Next steps (sales/ops):
- No AE outreach requested but owner set for tracking. Growth/Onboarding to push quickstart code bundle and short FAQ about quotas.
- Send recommended model/cost sheet and example streaming code (JS + Python).
- Monitor account for token usage spike; offer migration path to Dedicated only if demand grows.

Blockers / risks:
- Cost sensitivity — could churn if pricing unclear.
- Confusion around free credits and when billing kicks in.
- Early latency observations — may affect UX.

Tags / internal notes:
- PLG: indie-dev, micro-startup, chat/productivity.
- Good candidate for Redwood Optimize tips (batching/caching) once volume increases.
